scope: Script-to-transcript comparison of six synthetic clips. No human listening study. Ambiguous critical facts are not counted as correct; punctuation and harmless spelling variation are tolerated.
decision: Continue only with an editable draft and mandatory review; current setup fails an unreviewed-auto-save gate.

findings: 50%, 150ml, and no staggering preserved; no daily-total assertion added.
오후 세 시 → 오세시의: time is unclear.
휘청거림 → 위점거림: the finding is garbled.
직원 한 명의 → 지금 안 면리: staff identity/count is lost.

Daily amount still stated as unknown despite 종량 typo.
36.5도 and no pain survived, but 체온 → 채 오는 loses an explicit temperature label. Conservatively do not mark the complete temperature fact correct.
50ml and 150ml both present, but 아니 became 한; the correction relationship is ambiguous.
Half the lunch and no cough preserved.
Exact digital silence produced -감사합니다. -감사합니다. No patient fact, but unsupported text; silence handling fails.

interpretation: Do not publish an overall accuracy percentage from this tiny synthetic set. Voice identity differs between cases, so error causes and general human accuracy cannot be inferred.
